description: This is a Vite configuration file written in JavaScript that sets up a React development environment with custom environment variable loading, JSX support for `.js` files, and server settings including host binding and allowed hosts.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Defines the Vite configuration object with environment-based settings for plugins, dependencies, build, and server options.

methods.name: loadEnv
methods.description: Loads environment variables based on the current mode and working directory, prefix filtering included.
